build.title: Molly: console commands reach the embedded console; every app gets the control surface

said.text: Molly: console commands reach the embedded console; every app gets the control surface

steps.text: Reproduce in a headless browser: Molly with the Console frame, trace console-command@1
Commands work inside Molly: embedded console executes; client reported as molly/console-web; recent = the visible/focused client
Same for the axHub and AmberX frames inside Molly
console-wake path: wake/relay through Molly when Molly is the open app
Tests, report, THREADS, PR, redeploy
Addendum: apps_list + app-scoped targets (molly.*, axhub.*, amberx.*) on API, MCP and CLI
Addendum: app clients in Molly / axHub web / AmberX + template ships it; Plugin commands page grouped by app

Addendum (s6, s7): every app gets the Console's control surface (Molly, axHub web, AmberX: REST + MCP + CLI, `apps_list`, app-scoped targets, Molly relaying to its frames, the template shipping it, Plugin commands page grouped by app). Open in this build.
Molly without xLayout frames apps plainly (no embed marker), so no `show` / `shown` there.
The runner is a `node` subprocess per command; under heavy load that alone took seconds. Not changed.

Main's CI is red for other reasons (tracker status, plugin catalog, profiles, help coverage, session-checkin, kernel widget tests); `urgent-main-ci-green` (#284) owns that. This PR carries the same one-line xLayout `opens` fix.
Kotlin twin of the front messages: deferred (Android on hold).
Fable review suggested for the embed@1 contract addition (Opus-built foundation work).
